programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Drs Michelle Thornhill and Martin Dutch have seconds to spare as a man struggles to breathe. Dr Jonathan Papson fixes up an old friend suffering severe bee stings from a backyard hive.

programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: Every second counts at The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, as injured people pour in. Dr Luke treats an injured tradie hit by a falling tree. Later, he rejects a patient’s offer to mend a broken leg with icy pole sticks!

programs.title: Paramedics
programs.desc: Emergency responders face real-life crises, including accidents, medical emergencies, and rescue operations. The show follows paramedics, police, and firefighters as they handle high-pressure situations. Through real footage and firsthand accounts, it reveals the intensity and urgency of emergency services.
